decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with counter spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Force of Negation. The deck also includes efficient card selection and manipulation tools such as Ponder, Brainstorm, and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and maintain tempo. Additionally, the deck includes a small package of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast to deal with opposing threats and Mishra's Bauble to provide additional card advantage. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure smooth color access and to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland.

This deck revolves around utilizing lands to control the game and create a strong board presence. By leveraging cards like Life from the Loam, Winding Way, and Crop Rotation, the deck can quickly assemble powerful land combinations such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to generate threatening 20/20 indestructible creatures. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Maze of Ith and Wasteland allow for disruption of the opponent's strategy, while cards like Field of the Dead provide additional value over time. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through skillful land management and control.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost and efficient spells to maintain control of the board while applying constant pressure on the opponent. By combining disruptive cards like Daze and Force of Will with powerful threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also leverages card selection tools like Expressive Iteration and Ponder to dig for key cards, while using Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The overall strategy is to assert dominance early in the game and maintain it until victory.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by controlling the tempo of the game. By utilizing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, backed up by spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while also disrupting the opponent's strategy. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful disruption spells, the deck focuses on maintaining a fast pace and outmaneuvering the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using low-cost, efficient creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly. By utilizing cheap spells like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Lightning Bolt, along with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and consistency, while Wasteland provides disruption against non-basic lands.

The key concept of this UR Tempo deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly by deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to maintain tempo advantage by utilizing powerful cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to find threats and answers efficiently. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to finish off opponents or deal with problematic creatures. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining board presence and controlling the game through efficient use of resources.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token in order to win the game. It includes various ways to search for and manipulate these key cards, such as Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Wasteland and Prismatic Ending to control the opponent's board. The main strategy is to assemble the combo as quickly as possible while using cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to support the game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Rite of Flame, Seething Song, Jeska's Will, and Lotus Petal. The deck then uses this mana to cast high-impact spells like Burning Wish and Bonus Round. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation effects like Galvanic Relay, Reforge the Soul, and Wish to ensure a consistent flow of resources. The inclusion of cards like March of Reckless Joy and Reckless Impulse allow for additional card selection and can help to dig for combo pieces.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana and draw cards by playing multiple Elves and triggering cards like Glimpse of Nature. Once enough resources have been accumulated, the player can use cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to bring out powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth for a game-winning attack. The deck also includes protection cards like Allosaurus Shepherd and Wirewood Symbiote to ensure the combo can go off without interruption. With the ability to generate large amounts of mana and draw through the deck rapidly, this combo Elves deck aims to overwhelm opponents with speed and efficiency.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to utilize fast and efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the game with disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to tempo out the opponent by playing threats early and protecting them with counterspells. The deck also includes cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to help find the right cards at the right time, as well as mana denial with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler to generate card advantage and protect the player's own threats. Narset, Parter of Veils enhances the deck's ability to shut down opponents' card draw, while cards like Dress Down offer versatile solutions to a variety of threats. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents with efficient control spells and powerful card advantage engines.

The deck is focused on generating a large amount of mana quickly through rituals and mana rocks, and using cards like Burning Wish and Ad Nauseam to tutor for and cast a game-winning Tendrils of Agony. The deck also includes cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to cycle through the deck efficiently, as well as protection in the form of Veil of Summer and Defense Grid. The deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces for a lethal storm count and cast Tendrils of Agony to drain the opponent's life total in a single turn.

The deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, while also utilizing card draw and selection spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to maintain card advantage. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can establish their own strategy.
